---- MODULE ivy_examples_split_queue_2_new ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_split_queue_2_newDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgNatLib == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction

AgInv ==
  /\ begun \in [Nat -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ done \in [Nat -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ queue \in [Nat -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ firstq \in Nat
  /\ (HasUndoneFrom(begun, done) => FirstUndoneFrom(firstq, begun, done))

AgAt(c, k)  == AgInv /\ begun[c] /\ ~done[c] /\ k <= firstq
AgUp(c, k)  == AgInv /\ begun[c] /\ ~done[c] /\ k + 1 <= firstq
AgAtT(c, k) == AgAt(c, k) /\ queue[firstq]
AgAtF(c, k) == AgAt(c, k) /\ ~queue[firstq]

AgWC(x) == Spec => (begun[x] ~> done[x])

LEMMA AgUniq ==
  ASSUME NEW b, NEW d, NEW u, NEW v,
         FirstUndoneFrom(u, b, d), FirstUndoneFrom(v, b, d)
  PROVE  u = v
BY SMTT("r10") DEF FirstUndoneFrom

LEMMA AgExists ==
  ASSUME NEW b, NEW d, HasUndoneFrom(b, d)
  PROVE  \E z \in Nat : FirstUndoneFrom(z, b, d)
<1>1. PICK x \in Nat : b[x] /\ ~d[x]
  BY DEF HasUndoneFrom
<1> DEFINE Pk(k) == b[k] /\ ~d[k]
<1>2. \E m \in Nat : Pk(m) /\ \A i \in 0 .. m-1 : ~Pk(i)
  <2>1. Pk(x)
    BY <1>1
  <2> HIDE DEF Pk
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, AgNatLib!SmallestNatural
<1>3. PICK m \in Nat : Pk(m) /\ \A i \in 0 .. m-1 : ~Pk(i)
  BY <1>2
<1>4. \A y \in Nat : (b[y] /\ ~d[y]) => m <= y
  BY <1>3, SMTT("r20")
<1> QED
  BY <1>3, <1>4 DEF FirstUndoneFrom

LEMMA AgUnchAll ==
  ASSUME UNCHANGED vars
  PROVE  begun' = begun /\ done' = done /\ queue' = queue /\ firstq' = firstq
BY DEF vars

LEMMA AgUnchBQ ==
  ASSUME UNCHANGED << begun, queue >>
  PROVE  begun' = begun /\ queue' = queue
OBVIOUS

LEMMA AgInvInit ==
  ASSUME Init
  PROVE  AgInv
BY SMTT("r20") DEF Init, AgInv, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom

LEMMA AgInvNext ==
  ASSUME AgInv, [Next]_vars
  PROVE  AgInv'
<1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
  <2>1. begun' = begun /\ done' = done /\ queue' = queue /\ firstq' = firstq
    BY <1>1, AgUnchAll
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, SMTT("r20") DEF AgInv, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom
<1>2. ASSUME NEW lt \in Nat, NEW kind \in BOOLEAN, Send(lt, kind)
      PROVE  AgInv'
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r30")
     DEF AgInv, Send, UpdateFirstq, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom
<1>3. CASE Recv1
  <2>1. PICK x \in Nat :
          /\ FirstUndoneFrom(x, begun, done)
          /\ queue[x]
          /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![x] = TRUE]
          /\ UpdateFirstq(begun, done')
          /\ UNCHANGED << begun, queue >>
    BY <1>3 DEF Recv1
  <2>2. begun' = begun /\ queue' = queue
    BY <2>1, AgUnchBQ
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, SMTT("r30")
       DEF AgInv, UpdateFirstq, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom
<1>4. CASE Recv2
  <2>1. PICK x \in Nat :
          /\ FirstUndoneFrom(x, begun, done)
          /\ ~queue[x]
          /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![x] = TRUE]
          /\ UpdateFirstq(begun, done')
          /\ UNCHANGED << begun, queue >>
    BY <1>4 DEF Recv2
  <2>2. begun' = begun /\ queue' = queue
    BY <2>1, AgUnchBQ
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, SMTT("r30")
       DEF AgInv, UpdateFirstq, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4 DEF Next

LEMMA AgFirstLe ==
  ASSUME AgInv, NEW c \in Nat, begun[c], ~done[c]
  PROVE  FirstUndoneFrom(firstq, begun, done) /\ firstq <= c
BY SMTT("r20") DEF AgInv, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom

LEMMA AgSendKeep ==
  ASSUME AgInv, NEW c \in Nat, begun[c], ~done[c],
         NEW lt \in Nat, NEW kind \in BOOLEAN, Send(lt, kind)
  PROVE  /\ firstq' = firstq
         /\ begun'[c]
         /\ ~done'[c]
         /\ queue'[firstq] = queue[firstq]
<1>1. FirstUndoneFrom(firstq, begun, done) /\ firstq <= c
  BY AgFirstLe
<1>2. c < lt /\ firstq < lt
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r20") DEF Send, FirstUndoneFrom
<1>3. done' = done
  BY DEF Send
<1>4. begun'[c] /\ ~done'[c] /\ queue'[firstq] = queue[firstq]
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, SMTT("r20") DEF Send, AgInv, FirstUndoneFrom
<1>5. HasUndoneFrom(begun', done')
  BY <1>4 DEF HasUndoneFrom
<1>6. FirstUndoneFrom(firstq', begun', done')
  BY <1>3, <1>5 DEF Send, UpdateFirstq
<1>7. FirstUndoneFrom(firstq, begun', done')
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, SMTT("r30") DEF Send, AgInv, FirstUndoneFrom
<1> QED
  BY <1>4, <1>6, <1>7, AgUniq

LEMMA AgRecvGain ==
  ASSUME AgInv, NEW c \in Nat, begun[c], ~done[c],
         NEW x \in Nat,
         FirstUndoneFrom(x, begun, done),
         done' = [done EXCEPT ![x] = TRUE],
         UpdateFirstq(begun, done'),
         UNCHANGED << begun, queue >>
  PROVE  done'[c] \/ (begun'[c] /\ ~done'[c] /\ firstq + 1 <= firstq')
<1>1. begun' = begun /\ queue' = queue
  BY AgUnchBQ
<1>2. FirstUndoneFrom(firstq, begun, done) /\ firstq <= c
  BY AgFirstLe
<1>3. x = firstq
  BY <1>2, AgUniq
<1>4. CASE x = c
  BY <1>4, SMTT("r20") DEF AgInv
<1>5. CASE x # c
  <2>1. begun'[c] /\ ~done'[c]
    BY <1>1, <1>5, SMTT("r20") DEF AgInv
  <2>2. HasUndoneFrom(begun, done')
    BY <2>1, <1>1 DEF HasUndoneFrom
  <2>3. FirstUndoneFrom(firstq', begun, done')
    BY <2>2 DEF UpdateFirstq
  <2>4. firstq + 1 <= firstq'
    BY <1>2, <1>3, <2>3, SMTT("r30") DEF AgInv, FirstUndoneFrom
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, <2>4
<1> QED
  BY <1>4, <1>5

LEMMA AgSplit ==
  ASSUME NEW c \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat, AgAt(c, k)
  PROVE  AgAtT(c, k) \/ AgAtF(c, k)
BY SMTT("r20") DEF AgAt, AgAtT, AgAtF, AgInv

LEMMA AgStart ==
  ASSUME NEW c \in Nat, AgInv, begun[c]
  PROVE  done[c] \/ AgAt(c, 0)
BY SMTT("r20") DEF AgInv, AgAt

LEMMA AgUpFalse ==
  ASSUME NEW c \in Nat, AgUp(c, c)
  PROVE  done[c]
<1>1. FirstUndoneFrom(firstq, begun, done) /\ firstq <= c
  BY AgFirstLe DEF AgUp
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r20") DEF AgUp, AgInv

LEMMA AgUpNext ==
  ASSUME NEW c \in Nat, NEW j \in 1 .. c, AgUp(c, j-1)
  PROVE  AgAt(c, j)
BY SMTT("r20") DEF AgUp, AgAt

LEMMA AgStepT ==
  ASSUME NEW c \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat, AgAtT(c, k), [Next]_vars
  PROVE  AgAtT(c, k)' \/ done'[c] \/ AgUp(c, k)'
<1> USE DEF AgAtT, AgAt, AgUp, AgInv
<1>0. AgInv'
  BY AgInvNext
<1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
  <2>1. begun' = begun /\ done' = done /\ queue' = queue /\ firstq' = firstq
    BY <1>1, AgUnchAll
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, <1>0, SMTT("r20")
<1>2. ASSUME NEW lt \in Nat, NEW kind \in BOOLEAN, Send(lt, kind)
      PROVE  AgAtT(c, k)'
  <2>1. /\ firstq' = firstq
        /\ begun'[c]
        /\ ~done'[c]
        /\ queue'[firstq] = queue[firstq]
    BY <1>2, AgSendKeep
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, <1>0, SMTT("r20")
<1>3. CASE Recv1
  <2>1. PICK x \in Nat :
          /\ FirstUndoneFrom(x, begun, done)
          /\ queue[x]
          /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![x] = TRUE]
          /\ UpdateFirstq(begun, done')
          /\ UNCHANGED << begun, queue >>
    BY <1>3 DEF Recv1
  <2>2. done'[c] \/ (begun'[c] /\ ~done'[c] /\ firstq + 1 <= firstq')
    BY <2>1, AgRecvGain
  <2> QED
    BY <2>2, <1>0, SMTT("r20")
<1>4. CASE Recv2
  <2>1. PICK x \in Nat :
          /\ FirstUndoneFrom(x, begun, done)
          /\ ~queue[x]
          /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![x] = TRUE]
          /\ UpdateFirstq(begun, done')
          /\ UNCHANGED << begun, queue >>
    BY <1>4 DEF Recv2
  <2>2. done'[c] \/ (begun'[c] /\ ~done'[c] /\ firstq + 1 <= firstq')
    BY <2>1, AgRecvGain
  <2> QED
    BY <2>2, <1>0, SMTT("r20")
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4 DEF Next

LEMMA AgStepF ==
  ASSUME NEW c \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat, AgAtF(c, k), [Next]_vars
  PROVE  AgAtF(c, k)' \/ done'[c] \/ AgUp(c, k)'
<1> USE DEF AgAtF, AgAt, AgUp, AgInv
<1>0. AgInv'
  BY AgInvNext
<1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
  <2>1. begun' = begun /\ done' = done /\ queue' = queue /\ firstq' = firstq
    BY <1>1, AgUnchAll
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, <1>0, SMTT("r20")
<1>2. ASSUME NEW lt \in Nat, NEW kind \in BOOLEAN, Send(lt, kind)
      PROVE  AgAtF(c, k)'
  <2>1. /\ firstq' = firstq
        /\ begun'[c]
        /\ ~done'[c]
        /\ queue'[firstq] = queue[firstq]
    BY <1>2, AgSendKeep
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, <1>0, SMTT("r20")
<1>3. CASE Recv1
  <2>1. PICK x \in Nat :
          /\ FirstUndoneFrom(x, begun, done)
          /\ queue[x]
          /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![x] = TRUE]
          /\ UpdateFirstq(begun, done')
          /\ UNCHANGED << begun, queue >>
    BY <1>3 DEF Recv1
  <2>2. done'[c] \/ (begun'[c] /\ ~done'[c] /\ firstq + 1 <= firstq')
    BY <2>1, AgRecvGain
  <2> QED
    BY <2>2, <1>0, SMTT("r20")
<1>4. CASE Recv2
  <2>1. PICK x \in Nat :
          /\ FirstUndoneFrom(x, begun, done)
          /\ ~queue[x]
          /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![x] = TRUE]
          /\ UpdateFirstq(begun, done')
          /\ UNCHANGED << begun, queue >>
    BY <1>4 DEF Recv2
  <2>2. done'[c] \/ (begun'[c] /\ ~done'[c] /\ firstq + 1 <= firstq')
    BY <2>1, AgRecvGain
  <2> QED
    BY <2>2, <1>0, SMTT("r20")
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4 DEF Next

LEMMA AgFireT ==
  ASSUME NEW c \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat, AgAtT(c, k), Recv1
  PROVE  done'[c] \/ AgUp(c, k)'
<1> USE DEF AgAtT, AgAt, AgUp, AgInv
<1>0. [Next]_vars
  BY DEF Next
<1>1. AgInv'
  BY <1>0, AgInvNext
<1>2. PICK x \in Nat :
        /\ FirstUndoneFrom(x, begun, done)
        /\ queue[x]
        /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![x] = TRUE]
        /\ UpdateFirstq(begun, done')
        /\ UNCHANGED << begun, queue >>
  BY DEF Recv1
<1>3. done'[c] \/ (begun'[c] /\ ~done'[c] /\ firstq + 1 <= firstq')
  BY <1>2, AgRecvGain
<1> QED
  BY <1>3, <1>1, SMTT("r20")

LEMMA AgFireF ==
  ASSUME NEW c \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat, AgAtF(c, k), Recv2
  PROVE  done'[c] \/ AgUp(c, k)'
<1> USE DEF AgAtF, AgAt, AgUp, AgInv
<1>0. [Next]_vars
  BY DEF Next
<1>1. AgInv'
  BY <1>0, AgInvNext
<1>2. PICK x \in Nat :
        /\ FirstUndoneFrom(x, begun, done)
        /\ ~queue[x]
        /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![x] = TRUE]
        /\ UpdateFirstq(begun, done')
        /\ UNCHANGED << begun, queue >>
  BY DEF Recv2
<1>3. done'[c] \/ (begun'[c] /\ ~done'[c] /\ firstq + 1 <= firstq')
  BY <1>2, AgRecvGain
<1> QED
  BY <1>3, <1>1, SMTT("r20")

LEMMA AgEnabT ==
  ASSUME NEW c \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat, AgAtT(c, k)
  PROVE  ENABLED <<Recv1>>_vars
<1>0. /\ done \in [Nat -> BOOLEAN]
      /\ firstq \in Nat
      /\ queue[firstq]
  BY DEF AgAtT, AgAt, AgInv
<1>1. FirstUndoneFrom(firstq, begun, done)
  BY AgFirstLe DEF AgAtT, AgAt
<1>2. PICK f2 :
        IF HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE])
          THEN FirstUndoneFrom(f2, begun, [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE])
          ELSE f2 = firstq
  <2>1. CASE HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE])
    <3>1. \E z \in Nat : FirstUndoneFrom(z, begun, [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE])
      BY <2>1, AgExists
    <3> QED
      BY <2>1, <3>1
  <2>2. CASE ~HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE])
    BY <2>2
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>3. \E fpp, bpp, qpp, dpp :
        /\ (\E z \in Nat :
              /\ FirstUndoneFrom(z, begun, done)
              /\ queue[z]
              /\ dpp = [done EXCEPT ![z] = TRUE]
              /\ (IF HasUndoneFrom(begun, dpp)
                    THEN FirstUndoneFrom(fpp, begun, dpp)
                    ELSE fpp = firstq)
              /\ bpp = begun
              /\ qpp = queue)
        /\ ~(bpp = begun /\ dpp = done /\ qpp = queue /\ fpp = firstq)
  <2>1. [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE] # done
    BY <1>0, <1>1, SMTT("r20") DEF FirstUndoneFrom
  <2> QED
    BY <1>0, <1>1, <1>2, <2>1
<1> QED
  BY <1>3, ExpandENABLED, Zenon
     DEF Recv1, vars, UpdateFirstq, FirstUndoneFrom, HasUndoneFrom

LEMMA AgEnabF ==
  ASSUME NEW c \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat, AgAtF(c, k)
  PROVE  ENABLED <<Recv2>>_vars
<1>0. /\ done \in [Nat -> BOOLEAN]
      /\ firstq \in Nat
      /\ ~queue[firstq]
  BY DEF AgAtF, AgAt, AgInv
<1>1. FirstUndoneFrom(firstq, begun, done)
  BY AgFirstLe DEF AgAtF, AgAt
<1>2. PICK f2 :
        IF HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE])
          THEN FirstUndoneFrom(f2, begun, [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE])
          ELSE f2 = firstq
  <2>1. CASE HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE])
    <3>1. \E z \in Nat : FirstUndoneFrom(z, begun, [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE])
      BY <2>1, AgExists
    <3> QED
      BY <2>1, <3>1
  <2>2. CASE ~HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE])
    BY <2>2
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>3. \E fpp, bpp, qpp, dpp :
        /\ (\E z \in Nat :
              /\ FirstUndoneFrom(z, begun, done)
              /\ ~queue[z]
              /\ dpp = [done EXCEPT ![z] = TRUE]
              /\ (IF HasUndoneFrom(begun, dpp)
                    THEN FirstUndoneFrom(fpp, begun, dpp)
                    ELSE fpp = firstq)
              /\ bpp = begun
              /\ qpp = queue)
        /\ ~(bpp = begun /\ dpp = done /\ qpp = queue /\ fpp = firstq)
  <2>1. [done EXCEPT ![firstq] = TRUE] # done
    BY <1>0, <1>1, SMTT("r20") DEF FirstUndoneFrom
  <2> QED
    BY <1>0, <1>1, <1>2, <2>1
<1> QED
  BY <1>3, ExpandENABLED, Zenon
     DEF Recv2, vars, UpdateFirstq, FirstUndoneFrom, HasUndoneFrom
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Liveness == Spec => WorkCompletion
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_split_queue_2_new/ivy_examples_split_queue_2_new_Liveness.tla
<1>1. \A x \in Nat : AgWC(x)
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW c \in Nat
               PROVE  AgWC(c)
    OBVIOUS
  <2> USE DEF AgWC
  <2>0. Spec => []AgInv
    <3>1. Init => AgInv
      BY AgInvInit
    <3>2. AgInv /\ [Next]_vars => AgInv'
      BY AgInvNext
    <3> QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec
  <2> DEFINE Op(j) == Spec => (AgAt(c, j) ~> done[c])
  <2>1. Op(c)
    <3> USE DEF Op
    <3>1. AgAtT(c, c) /\ [Next]_vars
            => (AgAtT(c, c)' \/ (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, c))')
      BY AgStepT
    <3>2. AgAtT(c, c) /\ <<Next /\ Recv1>>_vars => (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, c))'
      BY AgFireT
    <3>3. AgAtT(c, c) => ENABLED <<Recv1>>_vars
      BY AgEnabT
    <3>4. AgAtF(c, c) /\ [Next]_vars
            => (AgAtF(c, c)' \/ (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, c))')
      BY AgStepF
    <3>5. AgAtF(c, c) /\ <<Next /\ Recv2>>_vars => (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, c))'
      BY AgFireF
    <3>6. AgAtF(c, c) => ENABLED <<Recv2>>_vars
      BY AgEnabF
    <3>7. AgAt(c, c) => (AgAtT(c, c) \/ AgAtF(c, c))
      BY AgSplit
    <3>8. AgUp(c, c) => done[c]
      BY AgUpFalse
    <3>9. Spec => (AgAtT(c, c) ~> (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, c)))
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec
    <3>10. Spec => (AgAtF(c, c) ~> (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, c)))
      BY <3>4, <3>5, <3>6, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec
    <3> QED
      BY <3>7, <3>8, <3>9, <3>10, PTL
  <2>2. \A j \in 1 .. c : Op(j) => Op(j-1)
    <3> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW j \in 1 .. c
                 PROVE  Op(j) => Op(j-1)
      OBVIOUS
    <3> USE DEF Op
    <3>0. j - 1 \in Nat
      BY SMTT("r10")
    <3>1. AgAtT(c, j-1) /\ [Next]_vars
            => (AgAtT(c, j-1)' \/ (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, j-1))')
      BY <3>0, AgStepT
    <3>2. AgAtT(c, j-1) /\ <<Next /\ Recv1>>_vars
            => (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, j-1))'
      BY <3>0, AgFireT
    <3>3. AgAtT(c, j-1) => ENABLED <<Recv1>>_vars
      BY <3>0, AgEnabT
    <3>4. AgAtF(c, j-1) /\ [Next]_vars
            => (AgAtF(c, j-1)' \/ (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, j-1))')
      BY <3>0, AgStepF
    <3>5. AgAtF(c, j-1) /\ <<Next /\ Recv2>>_vars
            => (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, j-1))'
      BY <3>0, AgFireF
    <3>6. AgAtF(c, j-1) => ENABLED <<Recv2>>_vars
      BY <3>0, AgEnabF
    <3>7. AgAt(c, j-1) => (AgAtT(c, j-1) \/ AgAtF(c, j-1))
      BY <3>0, AgSplit
    <3>8. AgUp(c, j-1) => AgAt(c, j)
      BY AgUpNext
    <3>9. Spec => (AgAtT(c, j-1) ~> (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, j-1)))
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec
    <3>10. Spec => (AgAtF(c, j-1) ~> (done[c] \/ AgUp(c, j-1)))
      BY <3>4, <3>5, <3>6, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec
    <3> QED
      BY <3>7, <3>8, <3>9, <3>10, PTL
  <2>3. Op(0)
    <3> HIDE DEF Op
    <3> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2, AgNatLib!DownwardNatInduction
  <2>4. AgInv /\ begun[c] => (done[c] \/ AgAt(c, 0))
    BY AgStart
  <2> QED
    BY <2>0, <2>3, <2>4, PTL DEF Op
<1> QED
  BY <1>1 DEF AgWC, WorkCompletion
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_split_queue_2_new/ivy_examples_split_queue_2_new_Liveness.tla
====
